pillars:
SIGNATURE PILLARS

Three questions every CFO
is asking about treasury.

Each talk, article and prototype comes back to one of these. Each answer is grounded in programs I have led, not in slideware.

01

Global Treasury Transformation

How do we see and move cash across every entity and bank?

S/4HANA Treasury & Risk Management, In-House Cash, cash management and Bank Communication Management designed for multinational scale, with dozens of legal entities and many banks feeding one view of liquidity.

TRMIn-House CashBCMISO 20022
02

Clean Core & BTP Architecture

How do we innovate without making the next upgrade harder?

Payment hubs, multi-bank connectivity and side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP keep the digital core upgradeable, while treasury gets the capabilities it has been waiting for.

SAP BTPClean coreBank connectivityPayment hubs
03

Enterprise AI Agents in Finance

Where can AI act, and who stays accountable?

Agents that propose and SAP that executes. Cash application, liquidity and exception handling come with confidence thresholds, approvals and audit trails built in from day one.
